trip.hotel: AX ODYCY, Qawra Coast Road, Qawra SPB 1902, Malta
trip.event: Thunderpick World Championship 2026 Finals, BLAST Arena Studios, Attard (Ta' Qali), match days 2026-10-14/2026-10-18

items.name: AX ODYCY on-site dining (Deck & Keel, Minoa, Sidestreet, Medusa, Pool Bar, Mamacita, Cheeky Monkey)
items.address: AX ODYCY, Qawra Coast Road, Qawra SPB 1902
items.hours: Venue hours not published in the sources read — confirm at the hotel front desk
items.price_range: Hotel F&B; all-inclusive rates exist (your booking basis to confirm); Minoa is mid-to-upper mid range
items.description: Your hotel has 11 food & beverage outlets: Deck & Keel (all-day buffet — breakfast/lunch/dinner), Minoa (Mediterranean à la carte with panoramic sea views — #9 on the island's Definitive(ly) Good Guide 2026 Top 10), Sidestreet (lobby bar), Medusa (adults-only sky bar, 10th floor), rooftop Pool Bar (11th floor), Mamacita (Latin bites & cocktails), Cheeky Monkey Gastropub (pub fare; 4.5 on TripAdvisor, ~3,034 reviews), plus a café. Sister venues Trattoria Riccardo (Italian, wood-fired oven; 4.8, ~2,360 reviews) and Luzzu (international/Mediterranean; 4.5, ~1,578) are a short walk away.
items.notes: Outlet names from the hotel's own site (9 Oct 2026) cross-read with British Airways' hotel profile ('buffet restaurant, three à la carte restaurants, four bars and one cafe', 11 outlets) and UK tour-operator profiles (cyplon lists Cheeky Monkey/Trattoria Riccardo/Luzzu as 'located nearby' rather than in-house — treat Riccardo/Luzzu as adjacent, not in-house). Cheeky Monkey/Luzzu/Riccardo review counts from TripAdvisor search reads 9 Oct 2026. Minoa's #9 Top-10 place from restaurantsmalta.com (verified 24 Sep 2026).

items.name: Venus Restaurant
items.address: Pioneer Road / Triq Il-Gandoffli, Buġibba, St Paul's Bay
items.hours: Not captured — confirm on the venue's listing before going
items.description: The strongest cross-platform signal near your hotel: #4 on the island's Definitive(ly) Good Guide 2026 Top 10 AND TripAdvisor's #1-rated restaurant in Buġibba/St Paul's Bay (4.8, ~2,900 reviews, Oct 2026 list). Steakhouse/seafood; reviewers highlight oysters, scallops, prawn tacos, rabbit arancini, beef wellington.
items.notes: TripAdvisor Buġibba list (updated Oct 2026) + restaurantsmalta.com 2026 Top-10 (verified 24 Sep 2026). Ratings/review counts are point-in-time. Book ahead for event-weekend evenings.

items.name: Sole by Tarragon
items.area: St Paul's Bay (walkable from Qawra along the coast)
items.description: #2 on the island's Definitive(ly) Good Guide 2026 (Best Service + Best Local Fish); seafood restaurant with sea views in St Paul's Bay — the closest awarded fine-ish option to your hotel.
items.notes: restaurantsmalta.com 2026 Top-10 page (verified 24 Sep 2026). Already listed on the Food & Drink page § 1.

items.name: Acqua Marina
items.description: TripAdvisor's #1-rated seafood restaurant in Buġibba (4.6, ~1,147 reviews, Oct 2026) and #1 for seafood lunch — family-run Italian seafood.
items.notes: TripAdvisor Buġibba seafood list (updated 2026). Point-in-time rating.

items.name: Ta' Rożi Restaurant
items.description: #2 on TripAdvisor's Buġibba/St Paul's Bay restaurant list (4.5, ~885 reviews): Italian seafood (ribeye steak also praised).
items.notes: TripAdvisor Buġibba list (updated Oct 2026). Point-in-time rating.

items.name: Trattoria 'a Lanterna cucina Ligure
items.description: #1 lunch restaurant in Buġibba on TripAdvisor (4.7, ~600 reviews): Ligurian/Italian seafood — 'stunning seafood 100% recommend' is a recurring review line.
items.notes: TripAdvisor Buġibba lunch list (updated 2025/26). Point-in-time rating.

items.name: Ta Pawla
items.description: High-volume local favourite (4.3, ~1,870 reviews): seafood & Mediterranean — crab and prawn pasta, tuna, swordfish; reviewers repeatedly recommend the rabbit and the seafood platter.
items.notes: TripAdvisor Buġibba list (updated Oct 2026). Point-in-time rating.

items.name: Chang Thai Restaurant
items.description: 4.7 (~240 reviews) Thai/seafood on Triq It-Turisti — 'the best Thai food we ever had in Europe' is a recurring review line; a change of pace from Maltese/Italian.
items.notes: TripAdvisor Buġibba seafood list (updated 2026). Point-in-time rating.

items.name: Luzzu
items.description: 4.5 (~1,578 reviews): seafood/Mediterranean; a Qawra forum thread calls it 'the most prim and proper breakfast (albeit a little expensive)' — a breakfast option near the hotel. Sister venue of AX ODYCY per UK operator profiles.
items.notes: TripAdvisor Qawra seafood list (updated 2026) + Qawra forum breakfast thread (2018, community). Point-in-time rating; venue status to confirm on the ground.

items.name: Zigumar Restaurant
items.description: #1 seafood restaurant in Qawra on TripAdvisor (4.4, ~293 reviews): Sicilian-style seafood — 'amazing food from starters to main to dessert'.
items.notes: TripAdvisor Qawra seafood list (updated 2026). Point-in-time rating.

items.name: Trattoria Riccardo
items.description: 4.8 (~2,360 reviews) near Qawra Point Beach — Italian with a wood-burning oven; listed among restaurants near Qawra Point on TripAdvisor. AX Group's own Qawra dining guide notes it has a play area.
items.notes: TripAdvisor 'restaurants near Qawra Point Beach' list (2026) + AX Hotels' own Qawra dining page (axhotelsmalta.com/malta-restaurants/qawra-st-pauls-bay/, May 2026). Point-in-time rating.

items.name: Victoria Gastropub
items.description: 4.3 (~2,034 reviews) — gastropub on the Buġibba list; useful for a casual, TV-sport-friendly meal near the hotel.
items.notes: TripAdvisor Buġibba list (UK mirror, 2026). Point-in-time rating.

items.name: Ocean Basket Malta
items.description: 4.1 (~1,683 reviews) — the reliable chain option on Qawra Road: seafood/Mediterranean, consistent, good for a no-surprises meal 600 ft from the hotel strip.
items.notes: TripAdvisor Qawra seafood list (updated 2026); hotel-booking aggregators show it ~600 ft from AX ODYCY on Qawra Road. Point-in-time rating.

items.name: UMI
items.description: 4.7 (~81 reviews) — Japanese/seafood (sushi tacos praised in reviews) on Bognor, Buġibba.
items.notes: TripAdvisor Buġibba seafood list (updated 2026). Point-in-time rating.

items.name: Nine Lives
items.address: Buġibba (Mediterranean Restaurant & Beach Club per event listings)
items.description: 4.7 — named among Buġibba's popular after-dark restaurants (TripAdvisor tourism guide); a beach-club-adjacent evening option. Hosted a Defected Malta 2026 warm-up DJ night on 1 Oct (bandsintown).
items.notes: TripAdvisor Bugibba tourism guide (2026) + bandsintown event listing (1 Oct 2026). Point-in-time; venue status to confirm.

items.name: Azure Restaurant & Terrace
items.description: 4.9 (~139 reviews) — #1 on TripAdvisor's Qawra breakfast-restaurant list ('excellent food and top service'); a strong near-hotel breakfast/brunch option.
items.notes: TripAdvisor Qawra breakfast list (updated 2025). Point-in-time rating.

items.name: Fluid Bistro & Steak House
items.description: 4.9 (~387 reviews) — American/vegetarian-friendly/vegan options; named in TripAdvisor's Bugibba essentials as a top pick.
items.notes: TripAdvisor Bugibba tourism guide (2026). Point-in-time rating.

items.name: Cafe Maroc
items.address: Triq it-Turisti (Hotel San Antonio), Qawra SPB 1024
items.description: #1 café in Qawra on TripAdvisor (4.6, ~216 reviews): cakes and coffee, organised and friendly staff.
items.notes: TripAdvisor Qawra café list (updated 2025). Point-in-time rating.

items.name: Knickerbocker Restaurant
items.description: #2 café in Qawra (4.2, ~694 reviews) on Tourist Street — a forum favourite for a full breakfast ('great value for money'). Tourist Street is Qawra's main strip, a short walk from the hotel.
items.notes: TripAdvisor Qawra café list (updated 2025) + Qawra forum (2018, community). Point-in-time rating.

items.name: The Meeting Point Cafe & Snacks Bar
items.description: 5.0 (~14 reviews) — small, top-rated snack bar on Tourist Street; cheap toasties/pancakes/iced coffee.
items.notes: TripAdvisor Qawra café list (UK mirror, updated 2025). Small review base — point-in-time.

items.name: Ombré Café Bistro
items.address: DoubleTree by Hilton Malta, Qawra SPB 2402
items.description: 4.9 — café bistro at the DoubleTree by Hilton in Qawra; #2 on TripAdvisor's Qawra breakfast list.
items.notes: TripAdvisor Qawra breakfast list (updated 2025). Point-in-time rating.

items.name: Central Perk Cafe
items.description: Popular local café near the Qawra bus station area (snacks, cheap beer, outdoor seating) per long-running Qawra forum advice; appears on the St Paul's Bay café list.
items.notes: TripAdvisor St Paul's Bay café list (2026, structured data) + Qawra forum (2018, community — 'mediocre' per one 2018 poster, 'popular' per another; mixed community signal). Confirm on the ground.

items.name: 9 Ball Cafe
items.description: 4.6 — café attached to the 9 Ball pool & snooker hall on Triq It-Turisti; a Qawra forum favourite ('I like 9 Ball, a good crowd in there, very friendly') and a rainy-day hangout with tables.
items.notes: Address/phone from bugibba-malta.com local guide; rating from TripAdvisor Qawra breakfast list (2026); forum colour from a 2018 Qawra thread. Confirm hours on the ground.

items.name: Café del Mar Malta
items.area: Qawra Point (next to the Malta National Aquarium, ~10-min walk)
items.description: The iconic open-air seaside venue next to the aquarium — daytime café/sunbeds, sunset drinks, and the weekly CDM Sundays session (see Activities: Sun 18 Oct is FREE, in your window).
items.notes: Address/hours from the venue's own CDM Sundays page (sundays.com.mt, read 9 Oct 2026); aquarium's annual-pass text confirms Café del Mar Malta as its F&B partner (aquarium.com.mt/tickets).

items.name: Pastizzi & budget bites on Tourist Street (Qawra)
items.hours: Shops/bars open late on the tourist strip; individual hours vary
items.description: Qawra's main strip (Tourist Street/Triq It-Turisti) is lined with bakeries, kebab shops and cafés — the cheapest eating near the hotel: pastizzi, ftira, toasties, kebabs. Mr. Kebab (4.2, ~341 reviews) and TimeOut are forum-named takeaway staples.
items.notes: Venue names/ratings from TripAdvisor Qawra café list (2025) and Qawra forum threads (2018, community); pastizzi price band is guide consensus (see restaurants.html § 3). Exact shop hours not verified — the tourist strip stays open late.
